targets.name: picoui_core
targets.notes: Current core includes backend headers and calls backend API, but ldgui objects are linked through backend targets.

targets.name: picoui_backend_ldgui
targets.notes: Legacy wrapper backend remains only for oracle/compat until P7.

targets.name: picoui_backend_ldgui_runtime
targets.notes: Runtime wrapper target must not be default after P7.

targets.name: picoui_demo_targets
targets.notes: Demo targets migrate to native runtime and must not link ldgui backend by v1.0.1.
